title.en: Devin puts the agent in a workspace
title.zh: Devin 把智能体放进工作空间

body.en: A task-oriented system combines planning, terminal, editor and browser. The precursor to delegating development rather than requesting snippets.
body.zh: 规划、终端、编辑器与浏览器组合成任务系统，为委派开发任务铺路。

body.en: A common protocol makes external data and tools accessible to models. It helps agent integrations move beyond one-off connectors.
body.zh: 统一协议让模型连接外部数据与工具，减少一次性的连接开发。

body.en: Delegated software engineering becomes a purchasable workflow; availability is distinct from guaranteed autonomous success.
body.zh: 委派软件工程成为可采购的工作流；正式开放不代表任务必然自主成功。

body.en: The IDE assistant can iterate on edits and commands, bringing tool use into the developer’s everyday environment.
body.zh: IDE 助手开始迭代修改并执行命令，让工具使用进入日常开发环境。

title.zh: Claude Code 进入研究预览

body.en: The terminal becomes an agent interface, with repository context, file edits and command execution.
body.zh: 终端成为智能体界面，结合仓库上下文、文件修改与命令执行。

title.en: Codex CLI brings the agent to the terminal
title.zh: Codex CLI 把智能体带进终端

body.en: An open-source local interface gives reasoning models access to repository code and terminal tools. Local work joins the emerging cloud workflow.
body.zh: 开源本地界面连接推理模型、仓库代码与终端工具。本地工作成为云端工作流的重要补充。

title.en: Cursor moves tasks into the background
title.zh: Cursor 让任务在后台运行

body.en: Background agents enter preview in separate remote environments. Developers can monitor, redirect or take over asynchronous repository tasks.
body.zh: 后台智能体进入预览，在独立远程环境执行任务。开发者可以查看、调整或接管异步仓库工作。

title.en: Codex delegates work to cloud sandboxes
title.zh: Codex 在云端沙箱承接任务

body.en: Parallel isolated tasks turn the coding agent into an asynchronous collaborator. Results still need review and testing.
body.zh: 并行隔离任务使编程智能体成为异步协作者，结果仍需要审查和测试。

title.en: Copilot takes issues through to PRs
title.zh: Copilot 从 Issue 走向 PR

body.en: Repository tasks connect to the pull-request review loop. The unit of work becomes an issue, rather than a completion.
body.zh: 仓库任务接入 PR 审查环节，工作单元从代码补全变为 Issue。

title.zh: Claude 4 与 Claude Code 正式版

body.en: Longer tool workflows and a generally available command-line product make agent coding more broadly accessible.
body.zh: 更长的工具工作流与正式版命令行产品，扩大智能体编程的可用范围。

title.en: Gemini CLI brings an open-source agent
title.zh: Gemini CLI 开源终端智能体

body.en: An open-source command-line agent broadens the ecosystem beyond proprietary editors and cloud services.
body.zh: 开源命令行智能体让生态扩展到专有编辑器与云服务之外。

body.en: An agent-oriented model emphasizes extended coding and review workflows, alongside improvements to the coding product.
body.zh: 面向智能体的模型强调长程编程与审查工作流，产品能力同步演进。

body.en: The focus shifts toward longer software tasks and agent scaffolding. Vendor demonstrations remain distinct from independent reliability tests.
body.zh: 关注点转向更长的软件任务与智能体框架；厂商演示需与独立可靠性评测区分。

title.en: Composer and a workspace for parallel agents
title.zh: Composer 与并行智能体工作空间

body.en: Cursor 2.0 pairs a coding model with parallel agents, isolated worktrees and browser verification. Review and testing become central parts of the interface.
body.zh: Cursor 2.0 将编程模型、并行智能体、独立工作树与浏览器验证结合，审查与测试成为界面的核心环节。

title.en: Antigravity connects editor, terminal and browser
title.zh: Antigravity 连接编辑器、终端与浏览器

body.en: Google launches a public preview with an agent manager and reviewable artifacts. Work is organized around delegated tasks spanning multiple development surfaces.
body.zh: Google 发布公开预览，提供智能体管理与可审查的成果。工作围绕跨越多种开发界面的委派任务组织。

title.zh: Cursor 研究长时运行智能体

body.en: Research on planners and workers explores extended autonomous coding. A successful experiment does not establish general unattended reliability.
body.zh: 规划者与执行者研究探索长时自主编程；成功实验仍不能证明普遍的无人值守可靠性。

title.en: The Codex app coordinates parallel work
title.zh: Codex App 协调并行工作

body.en: A dedicated app organizes multiple agents, isolated worktrees and automations around a developer’s projects.
body.zh: 专用应用围绕项目组织多个智能体、隔离工作树与自动化。

title.zh: ARC-AGI-3 检验陌生交互世界

body.en: Evaluation asks agents to explore and learn unseen environments. Coding success alone is insufficient evidence of general intelligence.
body.zh: 评测要求智能体探索并学习未见环境，编程成功本身不足以证明通用智能。

title.en: MirrorCode tests some weeks-long coding tasks
title.zh: MirrorCode 测试部分需要数周的编程任务

body.en: METR and Epoch AI report preliminary evidence on selected long coding tasks. Success on some tasks is consequential, but does not establish reliable autonomy across arbitrary weeks-long projects.
body.zh: METR 与 Epoch AI 报告部分长程编程任务的初步证据。完成某些任务意义重大，但不能证明对任意数周项目都具备可靠自主能力。

body.en: A major agent-coding product moves into a larger model and compute ecosystem. Product names and parent companies must be distinguished.
body.zh: 主要编程智能体产品进入更大的模型与算力生态；产品名称与母公司应区分。

body.en: New benchmark results broaden the frontier comparison. Different effort settings and fallback policies must remain visible.
body.zh: 新基准结果扩展前沿比较；推理配置与回退策略必须保持可见。

body.en: Anthropic reports 70.6% on Terminal-Bench 4.0. This is a vendor result on a defined task suite, not an AGI milestone percentage.
body.zh: Anthropic 报告 Terminal-Bench 4.0 成绩 70.6%；这是特定任务集的厂商成绩，不是 AGI 完成比例。

title.zh: DevDay 扩展协作式智能体工作流

body.en: GPT-6.1 Sol and Codex workflow updates put more emphasis on shared environments, review and coordinated agent work.
body.zh: GPT-6.1 Sol 与 Codex 工作流更新，更强调共享环境、审查与智能体协作。

body.en: Models write code, use tools and solve many bounded tasks. The selected leaderboard tracks capability, cost and speed; none measures all of intelligence.
body.zh: 模型能编写代码、使用工具并解决大量有边界的任务。精选榜追踪能力、成本与速度，但没有一项覆盖全部智能。

body.en: Coding agents can iterate in real environments. Sonnet 5.5’s 70.6% Terminal-Bench 4.0 result shows progress on a specific test, with substantial failures remaining.
body.zh: 编程智能体能在真实环境中迭代。Sonnet 5.5 的 Terminal-Bench 4.0 成绩 70.6% 显示特定测试上的进步，也意味着仍有相当比例的失败。

body.en: Working longer is different from succeeding reliably. METR distinguishes 50% and 80% task-success horizons measured in human expert task time. A task horizon is not an agent’s wall-clock runtime or a guarantee across arbitrary projects.
body.zh: 运行更久与可靠成功是不同的事。METR 区分 50% 与 80% 成功率的任务跨度，并以人类专家完成任务的时间衡量。任务跨度不是智能体实际运行时间，也不能保证任意项目都成功。

body.en: Robust transfer, learning in unfamiliar environments and dependable control still need evidence. ARC-AGI-3 reported frontier systems below 1% at its March launch; that historical baseline is not today’s leaderboard.
body.zh: 稳健迁移、陌生环境学习与可靠控制仍需要证据。ARC-AGI-3 在 3 月发布时报告前沿系统低于 1%；这是历史发布基线，不是今日榜单。

note.en: Best selected model configuration: Opus 5.5 vs MiMo-V2.6-Pro. A 12-point index gap is not a percentage or a measure of national scientific capability.
note.zh: 精选模型最高配置：Opus 5.5 对 MiMo-V2.6-Pro。12 个指数点的差距，不是百分比，也不等于国家整体科研能力差距。

note.en: AI Index 2026 reports 2025 private investment. China’s public funding is not captured equivalently; this is not total national AI spending.
note.zh: 2026 AI Index 报告的是 2025 年私人投资。中国公共资金未被等价覆盖；这不是两国 AI 总投入。

cn.en: The report finds a lead in publication volume, citations, patent output and industrial robot installations.

note.en: These measure different parts of the ecosystem, not a single winner or the reliability of a deployed agent.

note.en: Compare the actual licence, deployment cost and operational responsibility. Neither every Chinese model nor every American model follows one approach.
note.zh: 比较具体许可证、部署成本与运维责任。不能把中国或美国的全部模型归入同一种路线。

us.en: Chip design and hyperscale infrastructure are strengths; leading AI chip fabrication remains highly concentrated at TSMC.
us.zh: 芯片设计与超大规模基础设施是优势，领先 AI 芯片制造仍高度集中于台积电。

cn.en: Domestic accelerators and fabrication are strategic nodes to watch, alongside access to the global equipment and memory stack.
cn.zh: 国产加速芯片与制造是战略观察点，同时仍需关注全球设备与内存产业体系的可获得性。

note.en: Taiwanese fabrication, Dutch lithography and Korean memory make this a global supply-chain contest. This is a structural interpretation, not a claim of technological self-sufficiency.
note.zh: 台湾制造、荷兰光刻与韩国内存，让竞争成为全球供应链问题。这是结构性分析，不是技术自给的断言。
